 The players took to the pitch and the ball rolled for the Al-Faisaly vs. Al-Nassr clash
 Coverage by Victor Cunha Updated October 23, 2026, 9:33 am ET ADVERTISEMENT
 Live Last update 9:33 AM ET 9:33 AM ET 9 minutes ago HERE WE GO
 The players took to the pitch and the ball rolled for the Al-Faisaly vs. Al-Nassr clash, in the first 45 minutes of this 11th round Saudi Pro League match, with all the action and excitement of the duel here on VAVEL.
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 Follow VAVEL on Google 9:32 AM ET 10 minutes ago Al-Nassr's bench
 For the game, Ange Postecoglou will have the following names available during the match against Al-Faisaly: Abdulhadi Al-Alwan, Saad Al-Nasser, Salem Alnajdi, Majed Mohammed, Ayman Yahya, Ângelo, Sami Al-NAji, Haydar Abdulkareem and Saad Haqawi.
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 9:31 AM ET 11 minutes ago Al-Faisaly's bench
 For the game, Giovanni Solinas will have the following names available during the match against Al-Nassr: Mohammed Al-Hasawi, Abdullah Bin Subayt, Saud Haddad, Jaime Seonae, André Jordy Ella, Théo Bongonda, Abdulrahman Al-Shereaf and Faisal Al-Fahad.
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 9:28 AM ET 14 minutes ago Al-Nassr lined-up!
 With a 4-4-2 formation, Al-Nassr's starting lineup for the Saudi Pro League match against Al-Faisaly is: Bento, Boushal, Al-Amri, Iñigo Martínez and Aman; João Félix, Samu Costa, Al-Khaibari and Mané; Al-Hamdan and Cristiano Ronaldo.
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 9:26 AM ET 16 minutes ago Al-Faisaly lined-up!
 With a 4-3-3 formation, Al-Faisaly's starting lineup for the Saudi Pro League match against Al-Nassr is: Pacheco, Andrei Girotto, Seck and Jahfali; Barnawi, Flávio, Muwallad and Al-Shanqiti; Al Bishi, Mendy and Almogren.
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 9:18 AM ET 24 minutes ago Good morning!
 We're starting the broadcast of the match, with all the action and excitement of the duel between Al-Faisaly and Al-Nassr, in this 11th round of the Saudi Pro League, with the ball rolling at Majmaah Sports City Stadium, in this game between two teams from opposite ends of the table!
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 8:57 AM ET an hour ago Al-Faisaly vs Al-Nassr Live Score, Confirmed Lineups & Match Stats
 Follow Al-Faisaly vs Al-Nassr live score , confirmed starting XI and lineups, real-time goals, match stats, Saudi Pro League standings and minute-by-minute highlights from Majmaah Sports City Stadium on VAVEL.
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 8:44 AM ET an hour ago How to watch Al-Faisaly vs Al-Nassr Live Stream and TV Online?
 If you want to watch the Al-Faisaly vs Al-Nassr game live on TV, your options are: Fox Sports 2.
 If you want to watch via a streaming service or app, your options are: fuboTV, FOX Deportes, and FOX One.
 If you want to watch online, VAVEL US is your best option!
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 8:30 AM ET an hour ago Majmaah Sports City Stadium: Let's go to Majmaah for today's game!
 Finally, today's game takes place at Majmaah Sports City Stadium, located in Majmaah, Saudi Arabia. The stadium was inaugurated in 1990 and underwent renovations in 2025 to reach its current capacity of over six thousand spectators. Since its creation, the stadium has hosted games for Al-Faisaly, but it is also home to Al-Fayha and Al-Mujazzal.
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 8:17 AM ET an hour ago Upcoming matches: When and against whom do the teams return to the field?
 After today's game, Al-Nassr returns to the field in the AFC Champions League Elite on the 26th, when they host Al-Wasl. In the Saudi Pro League, they will play on the 29th, facing Al-Kholood, also at home. Al-Faisaly, in turn, plays on the 27th, in the Saudi Pro League, when they visit Abha.
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 8:06 AM ET 2 hours ago Al-Nassr's likely starting lineup for today is:
 In their 1-0 victory over Neom, Al-Nassr used a 4-2-3-1 formation, fielding the following starting eleven: Bento, Boushal, Al-Amri, Iñigo Martínez and Yahya; Al-Khaibari, Samú Costa, Ângelo, João Félix and Mané; Cristiano Ronaldo.
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 7:26 AM ET 2 hours ago Al-Faisaly's likely starting lineup for today is:
 In their 2-2 draw with Al-Shabab, Al-Faisaly used a 3-4-3 formation, fielding the following starting eleven: Pacheco, Bin Subayt, Seck and Andrei Girotto; Barnawi, Flávio, Almogren and Al-Shanqiti; Al-Bishi, Mendy and Seoane.
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 6:40 AM ET 3 hours ago Saudi Pro League: Here is how the competition standings look ahead of Matchday 11
 Al-Nassr is in third place in the Saudi Pro League with 22 points, two behind Al-Hilal, three behind the leader Al-Qadisiah, and two ahead of Al-Ittihad. Al-Faisaly, on the other hand, is in 15th position with seven points, one ahead of Al-Fateh and three ahead of Al-Taawoun, both in the relegation zone, and one behind Al-Fayha, two behind Al-Riyadh, and three behind Al-Hazem.
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 6:40 AM ET 3 hours ago How is Al-Nassr doing for today's game?
 Al-Nassr comes into today's game with three consecutive wins. On October 9th, at home, they won 3-0 against Diriyah, with goals from Coman, Samu Costa, and Cristiano Ronaldo. On the 12th, they won 3-1 at home against Neftchi in the AFC Champions League Elite, with goals from Gofurov (own goal), Cristiano Ronaldo, and Angelo, while Odilov scored for Neftchi. And on the 20th, they won 1-0 at home against Neom, with a goal from João Félix.
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 6:40 AM ET 3 hours ago How does Al-Faisaly arrive for today's game?
 Al-Faisaly comes into today's game with one loss, one draw, and one win in their last matches. On September 11th, they lost 3-1 at home to Al-Ittihad, with goals from En-Nesyri (2) and Bergwijn, while Bongonda scored for Al-Faisaly. On October 15th, they won 3-2 at home against Al-Kholood, with goals from Mendy (3), while Julien Domingues and Riley Pinas scored for Al-Kholood. And on the 19th, they drew 2-2 away against Al-Shabab, with two goals from Brownhill, while Mendy and Andrei Girotto scored the equalizers for Al-Faisaly.
 Live updates by Victor Cunha
 6:40 AM ET 3 hours ago Welcome!
 Al-Faisaly vs Al-Nassr face off live this Friday (23), at Majmaah Sports City Stadium, for the Saudi Pro League. The match is valid for the 11th round of the competition, with all the action and excitement in real time here on VAVEL. Follow our live coverage for confirmed starting lineups, real-time score updates, match stats, standings and highlights.
